description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email related to handling email URIs within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides a method 'unpack' intended to process email mailbox strings, but the method is currently unimplemented.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for email URI attribute definitions within the HTMLPurifier library, with a placeholder method for unpacking email mailbox strings.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: An abstract method intended to unpack a mailbox string into display-name and address components. Currently not implemented.
